policies.title: Catastrophic system operation
policies.summary: Blocks narrowly-defined commands capable of catastrophic host or filesystem damage.
policies.remediation: Use a scoped command against the intended project resource and document the target explicitly.

policies.title: Destructive repository or data operation
policies.summary: Requires explicit awareness before destructive source-control, filesystem, or database operations.
policies.remediation: Confirm the exact target, backup/rollback path, and why a non-destructive alternative is insufficient.

policies.title: Sensitive boundary modification
policies.summary: Marks writes to authentication, secrets, payment, and migration boundaries as elevated risk.
policies.remediation: Inspect dependent code paths and execute relevant verification before completion.

policies.title: Potential fake-success implementation
policies.summary: Flags code patterns that can indicate placeholder behavior being presented as completed integration.
policies.remediation: Confirm the placeholder is explicit test/prototype code or replace it with the real integration before claiming completion.

policies.title: Executable verification required
policies.summary: Requires successful relevant executable verification after source/config changes.
policies.remediation: Run the most relevant detected test, build, lint, typecheck, or project-specific check after the latest write.

policies.title: Sensitive edit without dependency discovery
policies.summary: Detects elevated-risk edits made without recorded read/search evidence in the current session.
policies.remediation: Inspect the target, callers/importers, related configuration, and tests before finalizing the change.
